content.text:
**Yes, CR-9202 can be approved, but only by Elena Novak, Director of Finance.** Acme is eligible for $650,000 on its own standing. Sarah Chen has no authority to approve any credit limit.

**1. The request.** CR-9202 asks to raise Acme's limit from $250,000 to $650,000. Sarah Chen (Enterprise Account Executive) requested it on 2026-09-23. The justification is the third-plant ramp-up, and it does not rely on the parent guarantee. One record issue: CR-9202 is not in `credit_requests.csv`. That file has only CR-9201, also Acme, also dated 2026-09-23, from $250,000 to $400,000, and still pending. Finance should confirm whether CR-9202 replaces CR-9201 and withdraw the other, so two limits are not approved.

**2. The customer.** ERP customer C-1001 (Acme Mfg. Holdings) is the same company as CRM-2048 (Acme Manufacturing). Both records share DUNS 04-812-7730 and the Milwaukee address. The CRM tier is **Strategic**. This is not Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091), which is a different company.

**3. The policy.** Northstar Credit Policy 2026 applies, together with the Strategic Concurrence Addendum, which took effect on 2026-07-01.

**4. Payment history.** The rule is that no invoice due in the 12 months before the request (2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23) may have been paid, or remain unpaid, more than 30 days after its due date.

| Invoice | Due | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | Paid before due date |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | Paid before due date |
| INV-62305 | 2026-10-02 | Unpaid | Not yet due on the request date, so outside the window |

The customer passes this test.

**5. The maximum limit.** The 2026 maximum for a Strategic account is $750,000. The requested $650,000 is within it, so the parent guarantee (GRT-ACME-2026, $400,000, which names Acme Mfg. Holdings) is not needed.

**6. The requestor's authority.** The 2026 policy gives credit authority only to AR Specialists, the Finance Manager and the Director of Finance. Sarah Chen holds none of these roles. She also submitted the request, so she could not approve it in any case.

**7. The required approvers.**
* A limit above $500,000 needs **Director of Finance** approval. That role is held by Elena Novak, who did not submit the request.
* The addendum requires VP Sales concurrence only for limits above $750,000, so **no concurrence** is needed.

**Note for the approver.** INV-62305 ($720,000, due 2026-10-02) is still unpaid in the records, and the open balance already exceeds the current $250,000 limit. As of today (2026-10-05) the invoice is 3 days past due. This does not affect eligibility on the request date, but the approver may want to look at it.

  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9202", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 650000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen", "basis": "standard"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 750000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §5: Strategic account maximum $750,000; no invoice due 2025-09-23 to 2026-09-23 paid or unpaid more than 30 days past due", "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 with CREDIT-POLICY-2026-ADD2", "requestor_limit": null, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"}]},
  "evidence": ["CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §3, §5, §6", "CREDIT-POLICY-2026-ADD2 (VP Sales concurrence only above $750,000)", "crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048 (Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730)", "customers.csv C-1001 (DUNS 04-812-7730)", "erp_credit.csv C-1001 current limit $250,000", "erp_invoices.csv INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305", "employees.csv / ORG-CHART-2026-09 (Sarah Chen is Enterprise AE; Elena Novak is Director of Finance)", "ERP request record CR-9202 as provided"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9202 does not appear in credit_requests.csv; CR-9201 (same customer and date, $400,000) is pending. Confirm which request stands."]
}
